The main takeaway from our work is that

coastal conflicts require the development of a more holistic approach to conflict resolution, which is not only based on the use of formal conflict resolution methods but also on the development of a long-term strategy for the transformation of power relations and the integration of different forms of knowledge.
coastal conflicts can be resolved, but only if the stakeholders are committed to a long-term process and if they are willing to transform power relations and integrate their knowledge.

the resolution of conflicts over coastal resources requires a long-term strategy of transformation of power and knowledge relations, which can be achieved only if formal and informal resolution mechanisms are combined.
